If the LED indicator does not show one of these patterns, please contact Hue customer support.

If the LED indicator on the front of your Hue sync box does not turn on, the Hue sync box may not be connected to power. Make sure the power cable is plugged into both the wall socket and the Hue sync box before continuing.

A solid red light means that the Hue sync box has already been installed.

You can add it to your existing set-up or reset it to add as a new device.
To put your Hue sync box in pairing mode, press and hold the power button for 10 seconds. The LED indicator on the front of your Hue sync box will blink blue.

A white light means that the Hue sync box has already been installed.

You can add it to your existing set-up or reset it to add it as a new device.

If the LED indicator on the Hue sync box is blinking yellow, the device has already been set up using a different network.

To add your Hue sync box to another network, you must enable pairing mode.
